services.name: Trail Rides
services.desc: Intermediate Camp is designed specifically for 11-13-year-olds! As our most popular camp, it’s packed with excitement and opportunities for growth. Campers get to customize their experience by choosing four of their favourite activities to enjoy every day. Each day also features dynamic chapel times filled with singing, inspiring talks from the camp speaker, and meaningful devotionals led by their cabin leaders. Beyond the fun and games, Intermediate Camp fosters lifelong friendships, builds self-esteem, and helps develop both physical and interpersonal skills-all while exploring and embracing spiritual values. blurb: Just 15 minutes from Regina, Dallas Valley Ranch Camp rests on 400 acres of natural Saskatchewan beauty. Our purpose is to provide an unforgettable summer camp experience with overnight camps for ages 9 to 17 and day camps for ages 7-11.
